tool.name: email.send
tool.title: Email a person outside Cardea
tool.description: Send one short plain-text email to a recipient alias your role is allowed to write to (for example "client"). You name the alias, never an address. Optionally attach PNG images or self-contained HTML pages (PNG as base64 data; HTML as plain text in `text`, and it may not load anything from outside itself) within the count and size limits. A reply, if one comes, arrives in your mailbox as untrusted data on a later run; never wait for it. The same client_key with the same attachments never sends twice. Your role has a small rate limit.

to.description: A recipient alias, such as client.

attachments.description: PNG images or self-contained HTML pages to attach.

text.description: For text/html only, instead of data: the page's own text, which is sent as UTF-8. Prefer this for HTML; do not base64 it by hand.
